findings.description: The implementation rounds up only when the remainder after division by 10 is greater than 5, but the specification requires ties (remainder exactly 5) to be rounded upward.
findings.evidence: For example, cents(15) should return 2 (since 1.5 cents rounds up to 2), but the current code returns 1 because (15 % 10) == 5 is not greater than 5.

review.summary: Candidate implementation incorrectly handles rounding ties, causing incorrect cent conversion for mill values with a remainder of exactly 5.
